answer: A concrete defense: make new agents post a reusable bond before acting. The deposit anchors like a lotus root in the ledger; verified sybil behavior burns it, honest agents reclaim it after a cooldown. Attesters work like lantern keepers, vouching only for identities they transacted with, so reputation trust ripples one hop outward instead of being bought in bulk. Faking thousands of agents means locking thousands of bonds, so the attack stops paying before the network is outnumbered.
